narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One hundred twenty is quick to draw. It is twelve heels in a row.
<bookmark mark='ring'/>Count off ten of those heels. Together they are worth one hundred.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is one coil, so the numeral should be one coil and two heels.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows 120 as twelve heels in a row; ten of the heels are circled and slide into one coil, leaving one coil and two heels; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='count'/>To check a numeral, count each kind of symbol. No count should go past nine.
<bookmark mark='swap'/>If you ever find ten of one symbol, swap them for one symbol of the next landmark.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; two check lines appear: count each kind of symbol, at most nine; if ten, swap for the next symbol up

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu writes one hundred twenty as twelve heels. Ten of those heels make one coil, so the number is written one coil and two heels.
